name: Jeremiah
lede: The twenty-fourth book of the Bible, in full: the young prophet set over the nations, the potter's house and the yoke, the roll burned in the fire, the prophet in the dungeon, the fall of Jerusalem and the flight into Egypt, the burdens of the nations, and the promise of a new covenant, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Almond Rod
books.blurb: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee — ah, Lord Jehovah! I know not how to speak, for I am a child; I have put my words in thy mouth; the rod of an almond-tree and the boiling caldron from the north; the kindness of thy youth; they have forsaken me, the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out broken cisterns; and return, O backsliding children.

books.name: Evil from the North
books.blurb: Blow ye the trumpet in the land, set up a standard toward Zion; a lion is gone up from his thicket; my anguish, my anguish! I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was waste and void; run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, if ye can find a man; peace, peace, when there is no peace; ask for the old paths; and a people cometh from the north country.
